title: Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization: Unifying LLM RL Algorithms from the Perspective of Divergence
abstract: arXiv:2610.13015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become the foundational paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Yet the dominant approach, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), relies on a geometrically degenerate clipping proxy that cannot adapt its resistance to policy shifts, leading to premature clipping and degraded exploration. Subsequent variants alleviate these issues through fragmented and heuristic modifications. We propose Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization (GPPO), a principled and unified framework for understanding and designing LLM RL algorithms through the lens of divergence. We establish a generalized $f$-divergence trust-region theory with a monotonic performance improvement guarantee, and show that different $f$-divergences induce distinct geometries and policy update dynamics. translated_title: 广义近端策略优化：从散度视角统一大语言模型强化学习算法
translated_abstract: 强化学习已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的基础范式。然而，主流方法近端策略优化（PPO）依赖一个几何上退化的截断代理，无法自适应地调整对策略偏移的抵抗，从而导致过早截断和探索能力退化。后续的各类变体则通过零散且启发式的修改来缓解这些问题。我们提出了广义近端策略优化（GPPO），这是一个有原则的统一框架，通过散度的视角来理解和设计大语言模型强化学习算法。我们建立了具有单调性能改进保证的广义 $f$-散度信赖域理论，并证明了不同的 $f$-散度会诱导出不同的几何结构与策略更新动态。我们进一步引入了新颖的估计器拓扑结构，相比传统的单样本蒙特卡洛方法，能够提供更忠实的散度估计。
tldr: 该论文提出广义近端策略优化（GPPO），基于带单调性能改进保证的广义 f-散度信赖域理论，从散度几何视角统一理解和设计大语言模型强化学习算法，克服了 PPO 固定截断机制无法自适应策略偏移的缺陷。
